result.title: A Two-Stage Hybrid Framework for Inferring Air Trips from Mobile Location-based Service (LBS) Data under Incomplete Airport Sightings
result.summary: Mobile device location-based service (LBS) data provide large-scale spatiotemporal observations that can help airport planners understand air travelers' mobility patterns. However, airport sightings are often missing before or after flights, making strictly rule-based detection incomplete. This study develops a two-stage framework to infer U.S. domestic air trips from large-scale LBS data under incomplete airport sightings. Stage 1 uses heuristic rules to identify high-confidence air trips whose endpoints are observed at two distinct airports. Stage 2 addresses latent air trips with a probabilistic model that infers air routes using spatial proximity, temporal compatibility, and historical flight schedule information. Using January 2022 nationwide LBS data with nearly 10 million users and 131 million sightings, results are validated against T-100 Domestic Segment route benchmarks and a Stage 1 pseudo-ground-truth reference set. The framework increases air route coverage from 10.65% under Stage 1 to 50.60% and recovers nearly all top-1,000 benchmark routes. It improves Spearman rank correlation with T-100 route shares from 0.4490 to 0.7630 and reduces Jensen-Shannon divergence from 0.2808 to 0.2263. Stage 2 also recovers 92.2% of Stage 1 reference trips. This study formalizes three endpoint observation regimes for LBS-based air trip inference (airport-observed, semi-observed, and latent) and helps airport agencies identify domestic air travel patterns missed when airport sightings are incomplete.

AI.brief_summary: 该研究面向移动定位数据中机场观测缺失的场景，提出两阶段框架（规则识别高置信航空行程＋概率模型推断缺失终点的 latent 行程），用 T-100 航段基准验证路线覆盖与排序指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于交通出行行为推断的领域应用，其「latent」指未被观测到的行程而非模型内部推理状态，规则加概率补全的流程未涉及视觉证据筛选、内部状态生成或推理停止决策，缺乏可供 LVR 借鉴的具体线索。
